description.fallback: In the Nubia region of Egypt, in Abu Simbel, a strange looking boy named Boingo sits and reads a comic book. Boingo is approached by an older kid, who asks if he could see his comic book as he is an aspiring comic artist and enjoys reading strange comics. Boingo gives him the book, and the kid begins reading.

text.fallback: Head out: "Khnum" Oingo and "Tohth" Boingo, Part 1

outro.fallback: The comic states that in Aswan Oingo and Boingo will find Jotaro, Polnareff, and Joseph, and they will drink tea that Oingo poisoned.
With Boingo's Tohth and Oingo's Khnum, the two brothers are invincible.
